Your Referral Engine

🎯

ICP & Impact

Define your ideal client profile in manufacturing and the specific outcome you create. Get crystal clear on who needs what you do.

  • Company size and type
  • Decision maker roles
  • Pain points you solve
  • Value you deliver
🤝

Strategic Partners

Map the specific roles who can send you business. These become your referral targets and expansion opportunities.

  • Complementary service providers
  • Industry influencers
  • Referral source companies
  • Strategic alliances
👁️

Visibility Strategy

Identify the rooms, events, and communities where your ICP and partners actually spend time. Focus beats random networking.

  • Industry associations
  • Trade shows and events
  • Online communities
  • Strategic relationships
⚙️

Success Habits

Build the daily behaviors that hold your referral engine together. Consistency creates compounding results.

  • Weekly follow-ups
  • Strategic introductions
  • Value-first content
  • Relationship maintenance
